name: seerly
description: Your brand's AI search visibility from Seerly: citations, share of voice, sentiment, gaps, briefs, page fixes and PR placements.

interface.shortDescription: Your brand's visibility in AI answers, and what to do about it.
interface.longDescription: Ask how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention, cite and describe your brand against competitors. Build a pitch from your numbers, plan the prompts to track, write briefs that close citation gaps, find the pages to fix for E-E-A-T, and shortlist the publications worth a placement. Needs a Seerly account.
interface.defaultPrompt: How did our AI visibility change this week, and what should we do next?
